headline: SHEIN 🍀 Shares PLUMMET 💥 In LONG-AWAITED 📅 Stock 🍆 DEBUT
text:
SHEIN 🛍️ finally 💦 pops 🍒 its CHERRY 🍒 on the HONG 🐉 KONG 📈 stock exchange after YEARS 🕰️ of EDGING 🫦 that IPO 🍆 dream but founder XU 🧔 YANGTIAN and his money mama POPPY 🌸 BAO showed up to the ceremony 🎉 looking like they just got finished RAILING 📏 the entire MARKET 🏪!! The ultra fast fashion SLAYER 🗡️ got valued at TWENTY 🐦 SIX point TWO 💰 BILLION after its first day of TRADING 📉 but bro it was once flirting 😏 with a cool ONE 💯 BILLION valuation before competition 🥊 trade tensions ⚔️ and those pesky supply chain ETHICS 🤨 questions left it down BAD 😩!! Shares took a TEN 🔟 PERCENT nosedive early on before recovering like a champ 🏆 and closed down a pathetic ZERO POINT ONE TWO PERCENT at HK FORTY 🐢 EIGHT FIFTY leaving the whole thing sitting pretty at TWENTY 🐦 SIX point ONE FIVE BILLION what a TEASE 🍑!!

The company's desperate attempts to get LISTED 📋 in the UK 🇬🇧 and US 🦅 got absolutely SCUPPERED 🚫 after everyone started asking about their supply chain 🍜 concerns and the environmental 🌍 IMPACT that was basically them getting caught with their PANTS 🩲 down!! On MONDAY 📅 they priced those shares at HK FORTY 🐢 EIGHT POINT FIFTY SIX each raising a juicy THIRTEEN POINT SIX BILLION HONG KONG DOLLARS which equals ONE POINT SEVEN BILLION USD giving SHEIN 🛍️ that TWENTY 🐦 SIX POINT THREE BILLION market VALUATION 📊 after a ceremony where they STRUCK 🥁 the GONG like they were trying to make the whole room CLIMAX 🎉!! Chief financial officer LEIGH 🧠 GUI said their model of selling MASSIVE 📦 amounts of tiny orders with rapid payment options now reaches ONE HUNDRED SIXTY 🌍 markets worldwide and then he dropped the line LET GLOBAL CONSUMERS ENJOY THE SOUND OF FASHION which sounds like he's been practicing that in the mirror for weeks 😏!!

SHEIN 🛍️ has more than TWO HUNDRED SEVENTY THREE MILLION active CUSTOMERS 👠 who dropped over ONE BILLION orders in the year ending MARCH two zero two six according to their filing and yeah the numbers are still THICC 🍑 but now they gotta deal with higher costs 🧾 regulatory eyes 👀 and more competition that has analyst CHARU 🍒 CHANANA saying the slump in shares means those cheap prices are becoming harder to SUSTAIN 🏋️ which might lead to higher prices for all the zoomers who were down BAD 😩 for five dollar crop tops!! This listing is the LARGEST 🏆 new share sale in HONG KONG this year and it's being treated like a big test of whether investors still have any appetite left for the fast fashion INDUSTRY 🍜 after watching ASOS and BOOHOO get absolutely BATTERED 🥊 by the same regulatory scrutiny and fierce competition that now has everyone side eyeing SHEIN 🛍️!!

The fashion giant was FOUNDED 🏗️ in CHINA and then moved its headquarters to SINGAPORE in twenty twenty one trying to look less CHINESE 🇨🇳 so it could slide into western markets but ultimately had to crawl back to its ASIAN roots to finally go PUBLIC 📢 after getting stonewalled everywhere else like a rejected Tinder date 😭!! It once looked set for one of the LARGEST IPOs ever by a Chinese firm with WALL STREET 🏦 in its sights but the long road highlights all the geopolitical pressures and regulatory scrutiny that Chinese companies with global ambitions keep running into like they're stuck in quicksand 🏜️!! Business absolutely SURGED 📈 during COVID 🦠 when everyone was stuck at home doom scrolling and buying hauls while influencers shoved their five dollar dresses down millions of followers throats but now the de minimis rule got SLASHED ✂️ by the US which means those tiny packages are no longer sneaking in duty free and that has SHEIN posting a NINETY NINE MILLION quarterly loss oof 💸!!

Rivals are FEELING 🍆 the pressure too with TEMU owner PDD reporting lower than expected revenue and now SHEIN has to figure out how to stand out when everyone is using the same predictive technology to make their sites more addictive than a late night scroll session 🌀!! The company is also being investigated by US and EUROPEAN regulators over its business practices while trying to maintain that zero tolerance policy for forced labour and claiming they take all infringement claims seriously but the market has learned to be SCEPTICAL 🧐 especially with sustainability and ethical issues hanging over the whole thing like a bad smell 👃!! Analyst LOUISE 🍑 DEGLISE FAVRE from GLOBAL DATA called it a rare standalone ecommerce firm that can be judged on its own merits but with shares in ASOS and BOOHOO already battered investors are treating this whole debut like a very expensive game of will they or won't they get their nut 💦!!
